verdict.rationale: Filee documents converting EPUB, Kindle and FictionBook e-books to PDF, EPUB and Word (filee-docs-19). It also ships Pandoc as an optional bundled engine (filee-docs-29, filee-docs-30), which implies markup conversion. However, no evidence explicitly names Markdown, HTML or LaTeX as supported inputs or outputs, so only the EPUB and DOCX part of the story is directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Markdown/HTML/LaTeX conversion paths, a documented two-way matrix across all five formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
